cases.title: The Consignment Watch
cases.tagline: A $4,800 pocket watch vanishes from a locked safe. The apprentice took the blame.
cases.hook: A gold pocket watch goes missing overnight from a small watchmaker's shop. The alarm log shows the apprentice let himself in at 22:14, and the first officer never looked further. The owner of the watch wants a second opinion. This is your first file, and a guide will walk you through the desk.
cases.note: New here? Start with this one. A guide shows you every tool.

cases.title: The Halvorsen Bequest
cases.tagline: A death in a cold store, filed as an accident. Is it?
cases.hook: A conservator is found dead in a refrigerated art vault. He had a heart condition, a written exemption barring him from that room, and he went in anyway without his monitor. The Medical Examiner recorded accidental death and the file closed in eleven days. Six weeks later the insurers refused the claim. You are the review team.
cases.note: Start here. This case teaches the whole system.

cases.title: The Ravensgate Interlock
cases.tagline: A storm, a dam, two deaths. The file says murder-suicide.
cases.hook: A storm cuts the road to a hydroelectric dam and seals six people in with each other. By dawn two are dead: a manager electrocuted at a switchgear cabinet, and a control engineer drowned in the intake gallery. Her credential card opened his cabinet and closed the circuit that killed him. The police found murder-suicide and closed the file in nineteen days.
cases.note: Play Case 01 first. This one opens with a crime already solved.

cases.title: The Ashcombe Dome
cases.tagline: A dead astronomer in a dome bolted from the inside. The door log agrees. Should it?
cases.hook: The director of a hilltop observatory is found at the foot of a ladder in a telescope dome that the caretaker had to force open. The file says he fell in the dark. The pathologist is not so sure, and the door log is a little too tidy. This is an Expert file: not every document in it is honest, and the truth may need more than one name.
cases.note: Expert. Two people are responsible, and one document is forged.
